title: Binary divisible-by-three DFA
goal: Show the complete three-state DFA that accepts exactly binary values divisible by three.

rubric.must: The initial marker visibly enters state R0.
R0 is visibly marked as the accepting state.
Each of R0, R1, and R2 visibly has one outgoing transition labelled 0 and one labelled 1.
The visible 0 transitions are R0 to R0, R1 to R2, and R2 to R1.
The visible 1 transitions are R0 to R1, R1 to R0, and R2 to R2.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: Image 1 clearly satisfies all five rules, while Image 2 lacks a visible R0, initial marker, accepting-state marking, and readable transition labels.
